design_notes.both_certificate_rule: The loop enforces the frozen F3 discipline itself: an Advance whose continuation-coordinate index silently changes is refused (Conditioning/ConditioningBelowThreshold), a Switch report with outgoing: None is refused (Conditioning/ConditioningBelowThreshold - the outgoing square system could not certify), a Switch whose outgoing is not the coordinate the branch was traced under or that does not change the coordinate is refused (Conditioning/InvalidInput). Only a Switch with a consistent outgoing certificate yields TraceOutcome::Switched carrying the frozen CoordinateSwitch. The loop never reseeds.
design_notes.domain_exit: trace_branch takes the chart domain (the four axis intervals in (u,v,s,t) from the fixture system's domain_maps) and returns Terminated when a reported box leaves it - a natural end with no refusal, distinct from every named refusal.
design_notes.identity_recurrence: ClosedLoop fires when a reported step's chart_box equals the FIRST step's chart_box (box id == first box id); the closing step is included so the recurrence is visible in the outcome steps.
design_notes.germ_classifier_scope: classify_branch_germ reads the reduced-branch-profile jets through the kit's plain-f64 direct-evaluation helpers (the kit's documented jet-reading path for consumers) and is machine-checked against germ_ladder; the reading stops at the second jet the kit provides, so an event whose first nonzero jet lies beyond order two is Unresolved (the ladder's stationary rung resolves at order two).
design_notes.continuation_coordinate_semantics: The loop treats TraceStep.coordinate().index as an opaque continuation-coordinate id and never interprets its numeric value; switch detection and the both-certificate rule therefore compose with whatever index convention W1's adapter produces at integration.
design_notes.h1: No unwrap/expect/panic-family calls and no module-level allow anywhere in ssi_trace.rs including its #[cfg(test)] code (tests bind results by match + process exit). Item-scoped #[allow(dead_code)] appears only on the wave-private seam items that cfg(test) exercises and W1's integration adapter will consume (mirrors bezier_isect.rs:403 and quotient.rs:366).
